definitions.explanation: Sesame seeds that have been ground or crushed in a mortar, releasing their oils and aroma. A staple seasoning in Japanese home cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すりごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Sprinkle ground sesame on the salad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧{和|あ}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すりごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Ground sesame is used for sesame-dressed vegetables.

examples.japanese: すりごま⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Ground sesame has great flavor, so it also works well as a finishing touch for miso soup.

notes:
Written as すりごま (hiragana) or {擂|す}り⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧ (kanji). Made by grinding ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧ (sesame seeds) in a ⟦{擂|す}り{鉢|ばち}→擂り鉢：07504_suribachi⟧ (mortar). Pre-ground sesame is also sold in supermarkets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すりごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to sprinkle ground sesame
- すりごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧: to mix in ground sesame
- ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧{和|あ}え: sesame-dressed vegetables (made with ground sesame)
- すりごま⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{和|あ}える→和える：05824_aeru⟧: to dress with ground sesame

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{炒|い}りごま→炒りごま：23447_irigoma⟧: toasted sesame — whole seeds that have been dry-roasted; crunchy texture
- ⟦{練|ね}り→練る：09751_neru⟧ごま: sesame paste — ground further into a smooth paste; used in sauces and dressings
- ごま: sesame — the general term for sesame seeds
